_note: Indicative mapping of M365 control findings to related CVEs / NIST 800-53 controls. Associations are heuristic (the misconfiguration class relates to the CVE or control); they are not proof of exploitability. Verify before citing to a client. CVSS scores are base scores from NVD where recorded here.

controls.title: Legacy authentication not blocked
remediation: Create a Conditional Access policy blocking legacy authentication protocols for all users.
Run in report-only mode first and review sign-in logs for legacy clients.
Migrate remaining legacy clients to modern authentication.

controls.title: MFA not required for administrators
remediation: Require MFA (ideally phishing-resistant) for all privileged directory roles via Conditional Access.
Exclude only two monitored break-glass accounts.
Review role assignments and remove standing Global Administrator access.

controls.title: Audit log retention under one year
remediation: Extend unified audit log retention to at least 365 days (licence permitting).
Export logs to a SIEM or storage account for long-term retention.

controls.title: External email forwarding allowed
remediation: Disable automatic external forwarding in the outbound spam filter policy.
Remove remote-domain AutoForwardEnabled settings.
Alert on new inbox rules that forward externally.

controls.title: Password hash sync without pass-through authentication
remediation: Evaluate pass-through authentication or federation alongside password hash sync.
Enable leaked-credential detection in Entra ID Protection.

controls.title: Conditional access not enforced
remediation: Move report-only Conditional Access policies to enforced after validating impact.
Adopt a baseline policy set (MFA, device compliance, legacy auth block).

controls.title: SharePoint external sharing unrestricted
remediation: Restrict tenant sharing to 'New and existing guests' or tighter.
Limit sharing to approved domains.
Set default link type to specific people.

controls.title: Teams external access unrestricted
remediation: Restrict external access to an allow-list of trusted domains.
Disable consumer Teams/Skype federation unless required.
